prompt: Read the SQL line in the timeline from the run you just performed. Which statement reached the database?
options: SELECT name, email FROM customers LIMIT 10
asserts: you can read the literal SQL statement the run produced in the timeline
pass_message: Correct — and note it is a perfectly valid SELECT. Nothing malformed happened; the tool just let the caller write the WHERE clause.
fail_message: Open the timeline pane and find the SQL event from your run. The answer is the literal statement printed there.
